title: The Lights Above Miller's Field
hook: Blue-white lights drift over a cornfield, the cows arrange themselves into arrows, and every scarecrow is wearing someone else's coat.
truth: An alien survey lattice has mistaken rural anxiety, livestock behavior, and crop patterns for an official human greeting protocol.

monster.name: The Field Survey Lattice
monster.instinct: To map emotional response by arranging the local environment into readable patterns.
weaknesses: a calm invitation given in plain speech

countdown.label: First Pattern
countdown.text: Cows stand in a perfect arrow pointing at the old meteorology station.

countdown.label: Borrowed Clothes
countdown.text: Scarecrows appear wearing coats and hats taken from sleeping residents.

countdown.label: Field Lift
countdown.text: A square of corn rises six feet off the ground and stays there, roots dangling politely.

countdown.label: Weather Answer
countdown.text: Every anxious question spoken outdoors is answered by a targeted gust of wind.

countdown.label: Witness Swap
countdown.text: A missing farmhand returns with soil in his shoes and no memory of the last twelve hours.

countdown.label: Survey Lock
countdown.text: The lattice decides Cedar Crossing has consented to full contact sampling and lowers a silent grid over the field.

clues.text: Fence posts with old iron wire remain untouched while newer aluminum gates glow faintly blue.
The cow formation points toward Orion before pivoting toward the meteorology station.
The scarecrow coats are taken only from people who witnessed the first lights.
Cold frost forms on corn leaves around anyone who admits they are frightened.
The old weather station needle moves when people speak calmly, not when the wind changes.
A handwritten welcome sign stops a light from descending, but only while nobody jokes nervously.

keeperHints: Start with rural inconvenience and social embarrassment before making the sky feel vast.
Let the cows be funny because the people are not treating danger lightly.
The lattice is not malicious; it is dangerous because it is confidently wrong.
revealPolicy: Reveal the survey through repeated patterns and emotional responses before naming it as extraterrestrial.
automationSafety: Do not force a player character into missing time without consent.
